0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets, who have not played a 2026-27 game yet, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Southeast and 2nd in the East. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 110-107 win in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
